ticket: Source maps are deleted after a build that uploaded nothing
reason: Verified on four guides: with no auth token the plugin logs "Will not upload source maps" and still deletes them (SolidStart 3,543 files, Nitro all of .output, Next.js all of .next/static, Astro the hidden maps it enabled).

ticket: The automatic delete glob does not match the build output directory
reason: Separate defect from the delete-without-upload one: SolidStart's default is ./**/*.map and reached 3,519 files under node_modules, Astro's is hardcoded to ./dist and left 27 and 26 maps in custom outDirs.

ticket: `@sentry/elysia` on Node reports the Bun SDK name and a `bun` runtime
reason: All eight Elysia-on-Node variants carry sdk.name sentry.javascript.bun and contexts.runtime bun/unknown; cross-referenced to the existing Elysia on Deno ticket, which names the same root.

ticket: The Lambda `_HANDLER` shim wraps the handler again, so `wrapHandler` options never apply
reason: instrumentHandler.ts:53,56 calls wrapHandler(patched) with no options and no already-wrapped check; captureTimeoutWarning:false on the user's wrapHandler still produced a timeout warning event.

ticket: Google Cloud Functions: an HTTP invocation splits into two root spans, and the callback wrappers never end the function span
reason: http.ts:48-52 continues the trace before startSpanManual, giving two sibling root segments; events.ts:69-76 ends the span only inside the callback, so a synchronous throw sends no function.gcp span.

ticket: Server segments keep a method-only name although the framework knows the route
reason: TanStack Start (name source ignored on a child span), Nuxt static routes (updateRouteBeforeResponse.ts:27 guard) and SolidStart; a cross-reference was added to the existing SolidStart naming ticket, which this generalizes.

ticket: Server segments keep a method-only name although the framework knows the route (Koa and Nitro halves)
reason: Not reproduced as the same defect: the Koa first-line import loses names because the SDK loads after koa, a documented limit of that install method, and the Nitro run gives route-named segments for static routes, only the unmatched probe is GET.

ticket: Cloudflare Pages: the file route never reaches the segment span
reason: Every Pages function route is GET with source url and no http.route; sentryPagesPlugin never reads context.params or the function path, a Cloudflare-package cause distinct from the Node naming ticket.

ticket: A server segment with no response keeps status ok
reason: Connect client-abort is ok with status code 200, SvelteKit and Cloudflare Pages throwing routes are ok with no status code; a cross-reference was added to the existing Cloudflare status-ok ticket, which this generalizes.

ticket: The `@sentry/nitro` peer range rejects every Nitro beta after `3.0.260415-beta`
reason: The shipped peer range accepts only 3.0.0 and two named betas, so npm install ends in ERESOLVE for both the Nitro and the SolidStart getting-started paths.

ticket: `@sentry/nitro`: `enableNitroErrorHandler` is untyped, and the dev server initializes the SDK twice
reason: captureErrorHook.ts:38 reads the option at runtime while only @sentry/nuxt declares it in a type; nitro dev initializes in main thread and worker and sends two segments per request.

ticket: Mastra: the built-in integration doubles tool spans, and the exporter marks non-streaming calls as streamed
reason: mastraIntegration emits two gen_ai.execute_tool spans per tool call from client_tool_call; the stream flag half is recorded as living in the community @mastra/sentry exporter.

ticket: The injection diagnostics report a state the build is not in
reason: Remix logs "Bundler plugin did not run" and injected libraries=[] on an instrumented SSR bundle, Nuxt on Deno the same false negative, Koa the opposite false positive; points at the existing Cloudflare and Deno silence tickets.

ticket: `SentryEffectMetricsLayer` fails to build on Effect v3
reason: metrics.ts:183-193 wraps acquireRelease and forkScoped in Layer.effectDiscard, which supplies no Scope, so the whole program fails to build on effect 3.22.2 and works on 4.0.0-rc.112.

ticket: `@sentry/effect` captures no failed effect and turns the Node defaults off
reason: No capture call exists anywhere in packages/effect/src and server/sdk.ts:17 forces defaultIntegrations to false, so the guide's own verify failure sent nothing in any variant.

ticket: React 19: the `reactErrorHandler` root hooks dedupe the ErrorBoundary event away
reason: With the page's own root hooks the boundary's capture, beforeCapture tags and captureReactException are dropped five times as duplicates; handled is derived from whether a callback was passed.

ticket: Svelte 5 runes-mode components get no update spans
reason: trackUpdates is built on beforeUpdate/afterUpdate, which throw in runes mode; the throw is swallowed and the warning only appears under debug:true, while the legacy component in the same run got its spans.

ticket: Framework and runtime packages do not re-export sentryBeforeResponseMiddleware, setupExpressErrorHandler, attachHapiErrorHandler, setHttpServerSpanRouteAttribute and setupKoaErrorHandler
reason: Already the work item of the existing Deno framework and Oak tickets (re-export the error handlers and the route helper from @sentry/deno) and of the SolidStart naming ticket; setupKoaErrorHandler, setupExpressErrorHandler and sentryBeforeResponseMiddleware are exported from @sentry/node and @sentry/solidstart today, so DOC-Q45 is a docs claim, not a packaging gap.

ticket: SolidStart 2: no instrument.server.mjs and no @sentry/solidstart/middleware subpath
reason: Docs only: the SolidStart 2 path already ships as sentrySolidStart from @sentry/solidstart/vite, the middleware is exported from the package root, and the run classifies all three findings as docs wrong with docs-side fixes.

ticket: Angular TraceService and component-tracking ops
reason: Only the documented op names are wrong (ui.angular.init against the shipped ui.mount and function); the observed behaviour matches the v10-to-v11 migration page, so no SDK change is implied.

ticket: Node prerequisite and engines mismatch
reason: Docs only, excluded by the task.
